info.name: swift
info.category: Compiled to native via LLVM — ARC memory model
info.typing: Statically and strongly typed; protocols with associated types
info.gc: ARC (Automatic Reference Counting) — deterministic, no tracing GC
info.runtime: Small Swift runtime; system frameworks on Apple platforms
info.design_notes: Swift compiles ahead-of-time via LLVM and uses ARC instead of a tracing collector, giving deterministic deallocation and no GC pauses. Value types (structs) are first-class, and the optimizer monomorphizes protocols when possible. Performance is between Go and C++ depending on how much dynamic dispatch survives optimization.
key_traits: No GC pauses — ARC is deterministic
Value semantics for many built-in types
